title: GOD'S PERFECT WAY
YOUR DIVINE SHIELD
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: majestic ancient stone watchtower at sunset
golden light rays piercing through heavy storm clouds
calm river flowing through a quiet mountain valley
peaceful sunlit mountain pass with light mist
solid rock cliff face under a vast open sky
quiet forest canopy with soft morning light

scenes.a: If you are standing at the threshold of a decision that feels heavy, stay right here.
As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
Lord, anchor our weary hearts in the truth of Your unchanging character and your holy promise.
When the path ahead is obscured, keep our feet steady upon the solid rock of faith.
We ask for your protection to surround our minds against every shadow of doubt today.
Grant us the grace to rest in your sovereign covering as we face the coming hours.
